status: predeclared before V5 implementation or outcome inspection

data.rule: No generation or evaluation of validation/OOD arrays before implementation, candidate configuration, evaluator and manifest rules are frozen. Known V4 validation cases are development only. Identical case/physics/sensor streams within all paired comparisons.

metrics.risk: CVaR90 of max(mean_deficit(policy)-mean_deficit(static),0) across cases, fractional boundary
metrics.end_deficit: original H terminal offered minus completed
metrics.tail_auc_deficit: sum of offered minus completed across fixed 32 followup minutes

bootstrap.method: paired family-stratified percentile 95% CI, preserve shared case IDs and regime pairing; resample cases within family; no pooling regimes as independent cases

primary.condition: lower95 of mean baseline minus mean candidate > 0

risk_point_nonworsening.condition: candidate risk <= each baseline risk + tolerance in every original regime

mean_noninferiority.condition: lower95 of 1.05*mean baseline minus mean candidate >= -tolerance in every original regime

loss_endpoint_point_nonworsening.condition: candidate mean <= each baseline mean + tolerance in every original regime

underload.condition: every original and applicable OOD underload episode: zero dropped work and zero resource moves through H+32, within tolerance

integrity.condition: all required fresh tests, unchanged frozen V4, V5 frozen hashes, scenario identity, full accounting, observation boundary, independent representative replay, negative tamper test, and deterministic repeat evidence pass; missing evidence is not pass

ood.condition: all six families and baselines must have complete paired evidence, no physical or causal violations, candidate pooled OOD risk and mean total_dropped <= both V4 hybrid and Capacity Balance + tolerance; report each family separately; original regime promotion also requires OOD gate
ood.rules: Define OOD physics and adapter before generation; equal observation interfaces, physical constraints and paired shocks across policies. If unimplemented or incomplete, promotion blocked.

development.selection: On development only, retain every result. Compare single changes and full candidate ablations; choose one config deterministically by count of original loss/endpoints failed vs Balance/V2, then risk point failures, then delayed_noisy mean dropped work, then delayed_noisy risk, then lexicographic config ID. All ties deterministic. No post-validation tuning. A failed candidate stays failed; a later redesign needs new predeclaration and new validation seeds.

targets_nonbinding.report: per-family paired intervals, worst cases, drop contributions, loss/latency tradeoffs; avoid claiming independent endpoints or calibrated stress probabilities

advancement: PASS only if all original gates, both primary comparisons, underload, integrity and OOD gate pass concurrently. Missing or incomplete evidence => NOT_EVALUATED/BLOCKED, never PASS. Engineering point gates are not statistical superiority; primary claims require both predeclared comparisons. Do not relax criteria after seeing outcomes.
scope: Synthetic control study only; no production control or real-world performance claim. Preserve v0.4.0 code and evidence verbatim.
